---
title: "Pre-Conference Survey"
---

The ICRC2023 Diversity session was held on July 28th during lunchtime.
The pre-conference survey was open July 8–21, 2023, using Google Forms.
A request was sent to all participants of the conference; approximately 20%
responded.

- **[Overview](overview.qmd)** — period, method, target, and response rate
- **[Questionnaire](questionnaire.qmd)** — the questions asked and the choices shown
- **[Response timeline](response-timeline.qmd)** — when responses came in
- **Responses** — per-question breakdowns Q01–Q22 (see the sidebar)
- **[Derived clusters](clusters.qmd)** — the cluster columns used in the analysis

All breakdowns are built from the anonymized, suppressed extract in
`data/public/` (see [About the data](../index.qmd)).
